description: This file defines logging mechanisms and structures for jemalloc's internal debugging and logging system, including macros, external variables, and functions related to log variable states and output.

classes.name: log_var_t
classes.description: Structure representing a log variable with atomic state and name.

methods.name: log_var_update_state
methods.description: Updates and returns the current state of a log variable.

methods.name: log_impl_varargs
methods.description: Internal function to format and output log messages with variable arguments.
